$comment: Where the Zudocs prompts live in AirPrompter. Identifiers only: the Agent key and the staging run key travel by environment or SSM (docs/PROMPTS.md, RUNBOOK.md); workspaceId only builds the desk's link to the agent's board in the AirPrompter console. hostedRunUrl is the AgentRunUrl of AirPrompter's dev execution stack (hosted staging, D7); ciAgentId is the zudocs-ci Agent whose placeholder bundle is committed under vendored/.

providers.$comment: The desk's provider switch: the model the reply is sent to on each direct API with the customer's own key, read from /zudocs/<environment>/<provider>-key (RUNBOOK.md › Keys). Remove a provider here and the desk says it is not configured.
